summary: Presents a list of Internet protocols and where each stood in the standardization process, with an explanation of the process and the terms used. It was reissued periodically as the status of protocols changed. It is now historic and was replaced by RFC 2300.

eli5.summary: It is a report card listing every Internet rule and how far along each one is in becoming official. A newer report card replaced it.

questions: what was the internet official protocol standards list
how did rfc standardization stages work in 1997
